insights.one_liner: Farm Frites is a Dutch potato fries maker in Oudenhoorn supplying big restaurant chains; an IND sponsor with an English-friendly senior sales job.

culture.text: A Dutch food company founded in 1971, headquartered in Oudenhoorn.
Works with leading international restaurant chains serving millions of consumers daily.

open.text: Farm Frites International B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one open job here, a senior sales role in Oudenhoorn, doesn't require Dutch.

growth.text: Revenue stayed flat while net profit fell by 30 percent.
Its Horsham potato factory reached a milestone.
